name: open-source-auditor
description: Takes one target repo from 'private and unknown' to a publish-verdict PASS for open-source release under Apache 2.0. Ships the auditor persona, six read-only sensors, the triaging PASS/BLOCK guardrail, the license applier, and the post-abort janitor as a single bundle. Requires an explicit report-folder argument - it never writes anywhere you did not name.
